elements.content: Nearly everyone had food for three days.
it was 96% for food, and 53% for water.
You can stock food by accident. Water, you have to choose.
So skip the giant kit list and start small.
Start with water, at least a gallon per person per day.
Next payday, add one shelf-stable food.
Keep it all in one labeled bin.
Try it today: add one gallon of water to your shopping list.
